title: ESK early support policy draft V1
description: An unapproved policy draft. All economic values are declarations, not funding evidence or permission to issue, invest, redeem, or distribute assets.

protection_scope.description: Unapproved alternatives. Limited funded loss support does not satisfy a promise to replenish all principal losses. Selecting any alternative never approves a policy.

principal_denomination.description: Declared denomination identifier, not a verified currency, price, exchange rate or repayment guarantee.

term_basis.description: program_window proposes a common protection end date. per_purchase_anniversary proposes an anniversary for each purchase; program dates then describe the admission window only. Closing admission never automatically clears existing obligations. This checker computes no individual maturity dates.

guarantor_id.description: Unverified identifier of the proposed responsible party.

minimum_return_terms.description: Required for review only if principal_and_minimum_return is selected; otherwise must remain null. The checker reports cross-field inconsistencies without approving or interpreting the text.

utcTimestamp.description: Actual UTC calendar date, years 0001 through 9999, whole seconds only. The checker additionally rejects invalid dates and non-increasing program windows. No 730-day, leap-day or anniversary rule is inferred.

ruleText.description: Explicit proposed terms, not approved executable economic rules. Unicode scalar values only; no leading/trailing whitespace or control characters.

longText.description: Unverified proposed terms or funding declaration. Unicode scalar values only; no leading/trailing whitespace or control characters.
